observations: Photo 0: A black camera lens standing on a dark leather-like surface, front lens cap on, barrel reads 'Canon' and 'EFS 18-55mm', with zoom markings 18-24-35-55 and a switch labelled 'AF/MF' and what appears to be 'IMAGE ST...' (Image Stabilizer) text.
Photo 1: Same lens viewed from the rear, rear cap on, 'Canon' logo embossed on the lens cap, no mount or electronic contacts visible.
Photo 2: Side/rear angle view, rear cap on, 'Canon' text visible on cap, zoom scale '18-55mm' partly visible on barrel, background is a patterned fabric.
No shots of the actual glass elements (front or rear, with caps off), no shot of the lens mount/contacts, and no video or image showing autofocus or zoom action.
No visible scratches, fungus, or damage, but caps being on in all three photos prevents inspection of the optics.

claims.evidence: No import sticker, box, or paperwork shown in any photo; origin cannot be confirmed from the images alone.

risks.risk: Lens may not autofocus or the IS (image stabilizer) may be faulty.
risks.proof: A short video showing the lens mounted on a camera, autofocus racking, and IS engaging.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working (manual focus only, no stabilization)

risks.risk: Internal fungus, haze, or scratches on the glass elements.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the front and rear glass elements with caps removed, ideally with a light shone through.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having optical defects (lowest tier)

risks.risk: Mount or electronic contacts could be damaged, corroded, or bent.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the rear mount and contact pins.
risks.if_unproven: priced as mount condition unknown, worst case assumed

risks.risk: Zoom/focus ring could be stiff, loose, or have zoom creep.
risks.proof: A video showing the zoom ring being rotated through its full range.
risks.if_unproven: priced as mechanically uncertain, worst case assumed

proof_requests: Video of the lens mounted on a camera showing autofocus and image stabilization working.
Close-up photos of front and rear glass elements with caps off.
Photo of the rear mount and electronic contacts.
Video of zoom ring rotation across its full range.
response.reason: The lens is clearly identifiable as a Canon EF-S 18-55mm kit zoom lens from the barrel markings, but no photo shows the optics, mount, or functional test, so it must be priced at worst case (functionality and optical condition unproven).
